rule.statement: Every headline naming a roster company is scanned for words on three fixed lists. Each of 51 positive terms adds 3; each of 69 negative terms subtracts 4; clickbait phrasing subtracts 12. One headline is capped at ±15. Those are averaged across the company's headlines and multiplied by 8, giving the -100 to 100 index.
rule.zero_means: The company was mentioned but no scoring term matched — neutral, not missing.
rule.null_means: The company was not named in any headline in this window.
